description: Veneer21 provides 2579 paired images of wood veneers before and after drying, collected at a real plywood factory. The provider describes 5158 PNG images, generally larger than 4000 by 4000 pixels, against a white background. Matching numeric identifiers connect the Wet and Dry folders so that a piece can be tracked through the drying process. The source links to a paper in which the images are used for visual product tracking with Siamese neural networks; knot and wood-fault detection are listed as other possible uses. Coverage is the source factory collection, whose location and acquisition dates are not stated. The dataset was published in May 2021. The page advertises open-access files for logged-in users but also contains a subscription-required dialog. That access conflict is retained; neither actual file access nor charges were tested. No explicit reuse licence was identified in the inspected description. No image, archive, paper or video was retrieved.
